models.name: 10-Amp Pro Brushless ESC (EFLA1010)
models.firmware_note: Also 6-10 NiMH/NiCd cells; 12 A burst for 15 s; BEC type not stated; supports up to four sub-micro servos

entry.confirm_signal: Two sets of fast ringing tones after 5 s at full throttle.
steps: Battery disconnected, transmitter on, throttle full (above 1.7 ms).
Connect battery and hold full throttle for 5 s: two sets of fast tones.
Throttle to centre (1.4-1.6 ms): 1 beep = menu 1.

announce.description: Menu N is N beeps after the stick returns to centre. The offered options are not announced; the manual numbers them 1 and 2 and ties each to a stick position (full throttle above 1.7 ms or idle below 1.3 ms).

select.description: Within 5 s of the menu beeps, hold full throttle to choose option 1 or idle (below 1.3 ms) to choose option 2. One lower-pitched beep confirms.

skip.description: Make no selection for 5 s; the ESC advances to the next menu.

scheme.confirm_signal: One lower-pitched beep after a valid selection.
scheme.exit: Idle for about 8 s until three rising tones (armed), or unplug the battery.
scheme.description: At full throttle power-up the ESC enters programming after 5 s. Centre stick gives menu N as N beeps. Full throttle or idle within 5 s picks option 1 or 2 of that menu; centre stick moves on. Menu 1 has a hidden third value reached by holding full throttle for 7 s until 7 beeps.

items.name: Voltage cutoff

values.name: 3S Li-Po cutoff (9 V), stick full throttle
2S Li-Po or Ni-Cd/Ni-MH cutoff (6 V), stick idle
70% Smart Cut soft cutoff, hold full throttle 7 s until 7 beeps

items.note: Default 3S (9 V) as stated in the manual defaults list.

values.name: 4 poles and more, stick full throttle

unknowns: Duration, gap and pitch of the menu beeps: not stated.
Whether the 7 s hold in menu 1 re-announces 7 beeps once or repeats: not stated.
Wait between the 5 s power-up hold and the two tone sets is exactly 5 s per the manual; tolerance not stated.
Beep count for confirmation: 'one lower tone'; its length is not stated.
BEC type and BEC voltage: not stated.
notes: Option numbers 1 and 2 are the manual's own list numbering, not beeps; each is selected by stick position.
The 70% Smart Cut value is reached only by holding full throttle in menu 1 for 7 s, not by a stick position of its own.
